newsitem.title: CHINA: China sugar output seen 6.6 mln T in 1996/1997.
newsitem.headline: China sugar output seen 6.6 mln T in 1996/1997.

text.p: China's sugar output is expected to climb to 6.6 million tonnes in the 1996/97 (Oct/April) production season, up 380,000 tonnes from the previous season, an official from the Sugar Association said on Friday.
Some 64 million tonnes of sugar was expected to be reaped from 1.44 million hectares this season, the sugar official said by telephone, but declined to elaborate.
Of the total, 5.21 million tonnes would come from sugarcane, up nearly 280,000 tonnes from last season, the China Information Market Weekly said.
The rest would come from beet, with output rising by 100,000 tonnes from 1995/96 season, it said.
China's sugar output for the first 11 months of 1996 reached 4.9726 million tonnes, up 16.53 percent from a year ago, official figures showed.
